inputs.text: A half-body bust portrait cropped tight at the waist, of Lord Hanuman, the divine vanara, a noble monkey-faced hero: a monkey face with a short rounded muzzle, a wide flat nose, round ears and short saffron-orange fur on his face and arms, kind devoted eyes and a gentle smile. A tall golden mukuta crown, a red vermilion tilak, gold armlets, a pearl necklace and a saffron sash at his waist. His right hand grips the handle of a large golden gada mace held close, its heavy round head resting on his right shoulder beside his crown. His left palm rests on his heart. Two arms. Saffron orange, vermilion and gold. Bold hand-painted game-art character portrait with confident dark ink outlines, rich painterly detail, luminous warm rim light and ornate Indian gold jewellery, in the spirit of classical Indian temple murals and Pahari miniatures. A living figure with naturally shaded skin and open, alert eyes. Half-body portrait cropped at the waist, three-quarter view turned slightly right, head fully in frame. Alone before a flat, even, medium-grey backdrop filling the whole image.
